title: AI as a Tool for Fair Journalism: Case Studies from Malta

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the on-screen time and visual exposure of specific individuals in television news segments using face detection, tracking, and optical character recognition (OCR) for name extraction.

Analyzing news articles by computing sentiment scores for named entities and correlating them with image-text matching similarity scores generated by Vision Language Pre-training (VLP) models to assess image relevance.
